job: Assign existing Deez Prints Cloudinary shoots and present localhost preview only

sourceArchive.compressionLosslessness: NOT_ESTABLISHED; PNG encoding alone does not prove the previous compression was lossless.

cloudinary.assetResolution: Use configured Cloudinary access to resolve the exact existing folder and list all its assets with pagination. The console folder identifier is not a delivery URL or an assumed public-ID prefix. Record each actual public_id and secure_url returned by Cloudinary. Do not construct URLs from the folder name.

workflow.stopAfter: Provide the running localhost URL, verification results, and resolved assignment report; wait for the user to review before any deployment or production mutation.

instructions: Read this final JSON instead of any older manifest. The supplied compressed archive contains actual PNG files with .png extensions, NOT WebP. Do not assume a .webp conversion.

Work in the existing website project. Implement a local preview first. If product data normally persists to a production backend, use a local override or local fixture instead of writing to production.
Reuse assets already uploaded to the specified Cloudinary folder. Do not upload, reupload, rename, overwrite, move, or delete any Cloudinary asset. Do not generate bulk transformations.

List all assets in the exact resolved folder using configured Cloudinary access, including all pages of results. If access is unavailable, report the blocker rather than uploading local files or fabricating asset URLs.
Only images[] entries with renameAllowed=true are eligible. excludedReviewEntries[] are NOT assignments, regardless of any candidate page URLs.

Match fileName exactly. If Cloudinary assigned random IDs or a unique suffix, use its original-filename metadata or display name to establish the exact original filename. An original_filename without an extension may be matched to the manifest filename stem after confirming the asset format. Require exactly one eligible Cloudinary asset per image. Do not use substring, character-name, or fuzzy matching.
Record the real Cloudinary public_id and secure_url for every matched file. Null cloudinaryAsset fields mean unresolved, not permission to invent URLs. They must be resolved before assignment.

The evidenceImageURLs fields are old product reference photos. They are NOT the new model-shoot delivery URLs. originalShootSha256 is historical; sha256 describes this newly supplied compressed PNG. Neither should be equated to a Cloudinary ETag or a transformed delivery hash.

Match each exact productSlug against the current local catalogue and verify its fit. Acid wash and drop shoulder remain separate. Numeric slug suffixes are part of product identity. Do not modify regular-fit products or substitute similar artwork, characters, colours, or fits.

Use coverPriority=1 as the product cover and first gallery image. Add coverPriority=2 as an additional gallery image on that same exact page. Preserve existing product photos and their relative order after the new cover. Avoid duplicate gallery URLs and make reruns idempotent.
Keep combined two-model/front-back photographs intact. Do not crop, split, regenerate, resize, or rename these images as part of assignment.

Preserve all unrelated site content and product information, including product slugs, names, prices, stock, colour choices, descriptions, navigation, and checkout behavior. Keep any catalogue warning recorded on an image visible in the implementation report.

Validate the complete proposed filename-to-asset-to-product mapping before editing local product presentation. Apply only uniquely resolved valid matches locally; leave unresolved entries unchanged and report their precise reasons. Do not silently lower the expected scope or claim all entries succeeded when some did not.

Start the development server and report the actual localhost URL. Verify all 130 intended page assignments programmatically, check that every assigned image loads, verify 130 unique covers and 2 additional images, and confirm zero regular-product changes. Visually inspect the local collection grid and representative acid-wash, drop-shoulder, and combined-model product pages.

Run the existing project checks relevant to the changes. Produce a resolved assignment report listing fileName, productSlug, fit, colour, assignmentRole, public_id, secure_url, and status/reason for every one of the 132 entries.

STOP AT LOCALHOST. Do not deploy, publish, push commits, update a production database, or claim the live website changed. Show the local preview and report, then wait for explicit user approval before proceeding to production.

excludedReviewEntries.notes: Astral Ruins is listed only as drop shoulder in the current catalogue. The acid-wash version has no verified live product page; the obvious acid slug returns 404. Do not assign to the drop-shoulder page.

The armoured Guts / helmet-and-brand duo matches the drop-shoulder artwork, but no matching acid-wash product page was found. Other acid Berserk pages show different designs. Do not assign to drop shoulder.

The visible back design appears on BOTH acid-wash Berserk pages below. Their fronts differ (red Berserk wordmark versus white ornamental emblem), and the shoot shows no front. A unique page cannot be established from this image alone.

The action/blade artwork matches chainsaw-1, which currently lists Black and Grey only. The live Blue chainsaw-2 image has the different collared-shirt Denji design. Do not assign this Blue action-art shoot to chainsaw-2.

This duo has a cloud border along the front hem and a text-free seated Gear 5 back. The live Beige drop-shoulder luffy-1 has no cloud border and a ONE PIECE / GEAR5 text design on its back. The matching cloud-border design is listed in acid wash, which is a different fit. Do not merge them.
